title: Draft a journey *in a minute.*
intro: Choose countries and interests, write us a line, and our AI trip designer sketches a day-by-day draft. Then our team in Tbilisi makes it real.

form.label: Travel document
form.title: Your trip, *in a few stamps.*
form.hint: Tap the stamps that fit your trip, then write us a line. Nothing is booked: you get a draft to send us.
form.countriesError: Please choose at least one country.
form.experiencesHint: Leave them all blank for a balanced mix.
form.letterPlaceholder: we are twelve friends from Verona who love wine, long lunches and easy walks…
form.letterHint: Who is travelling, what they love, anything to avoid. Please leave out personal details.
form.micPrivacy: Voice input uses your browser’s speech service: your voice is processed by the company behind your browser (for example Google or Apple), not by Local Host.
form.privacy: To draft your plan, your choices and letter are processed by an AI model (Claude, by Anthropic).
form.disclaimer: An AI draft is a starting point, not an offer: prices, availability and every detail are confirmed by the Local Host team.

demoBefore: Demo preview: the AI trip designer isn’t switched on yet. After you fill this in you will see a ready-made sample itinerary, not one written for you. Your choices are kept, and you can send them to our team as an enquiry.

output.title: Draft itinerary
output.done: Draft ready: {days} days, {stops} stops on the map.
output.doneDemo: Sample ready: {days} days, {stops} stops on the map.
output.stopped: Stopped. The draft so far is below.
output.demoNotice: Demo mode: the live AI planner isn’t connected yet, so you see a ready-made sample, not a plan written for you. You can still send your choices to our team.
output.rateLimited: Please wait about {minutes} min before the next try.
output.sampleKicker: Sample · not written for your request

actions.sendDemoHint: Opens your email app with your own choices filled in, not the sample. Nothing is sent until you press send.

nojs.title: The trip designer needs JavaScript
nojs.text: It runs in your browser. You can also simply write to us: tell us the countries, interests, dates and size of your group, and we will come back with a first draft.
nojs.subject: Trip request

steps.title: Stamp your trip
steps.text: Countries, experiences, length and pace — and a line about who is travelling.

steps.title: Watch the draft appear
steps.text: Our AI trip designer writes a day-by-day plan and draws the route, using the places and experiences we work with.

steps.title: Send it to Tbilisi
steps.text: Our team checks every detail and turns your draft into a tailored programme.

demo.intro: Choose countries and interests, write us a line and see a sample itinerary, day by day. Then send your choices to our team in Tbilisi, who plan the real trip.
demo.hint: Tap the stamps that fit your trip, then write us a line. Nothing is booked: you see a sample and can send us your choices.
demo.privacy: Demo: your choices are used only to pick the closest sample. Nothing goes to an AI service, and nothing reaches our team unless you email it.
demo.disclaimer: A sample is an example, not an offer: our team in Tbilisi plans your trip and confirms prices and availability.
